name: git-diff
description: Show the git diff of changes made during the Run. Captures what files were modified and the specific changes in each file.

inputs.name: staged
inputs.description: If true, show only staged changes (--cached). If false, show all unstaged changes.

outputs.name: diff
outputs.description: The unified diff output showing all file changes.

failureConditions.signal: git diff exits with 'not a git repository'
